resources.string: No WiFi yet. Connect the headunit to your iPhone\'s hotspot.
Still in beta: the KlikBeam iPhone app is not available yet. Pairing code %1$s; how to connect is in Settings › Launcher › KLIKBEAM.

Mirror your iPhone screen to the headunit over WiFi. Still in beta and not usable yet: waiting for the KlikBeam iPhone app to be released.

How to connect: join the headunit to your iPhone's hotspot, tap OPEN RECEIVER, then in KlikBeam pick this headunit and enter pairing code %1$s. If the headunit does not show up, type the address: %2$s.

Note: mirroring works the iPhone hard (screen recording, video encoding, WiFi), so it can get hot and drain the battery quickly, especially in a car parked in the sun. Keep it charging, place it where the AC reaches it, and stop the broadcast if the iPhone feels hot.
Floating mode needs permission to show over other apps. Turn on USB debugging (Android Settings › Developer options), then try again.
iPhone mirror is on. Tap for full screen.
